Calculator.faqSubtitle: A few answers about your estimate
Calculator.faq1Q: Is this the complete landed cost?
Calculator.faq1A: The total only includes the import fees listed in the breakdown. It excludes the vehicle price, freight, insurance and other unlisted costs. Confirm your full budget for the specific vehicle and transport route.
Calculator.faq2Q: Can both private and business importers use it?
Calculator.faq2A: Kyrgyzstan lets you switch between personal and business imports. Check the policy notes for each other destination. The Tajikistan and Turkmenistan calculators currently cover personal-use imports.
Calculator.faq3Q: Why is an amount sometimes unavailable?
Calculator.faq3A: Nine destinations provide estimates for supported scenarios. The calculator explains when details are missing, the clearance date is outside coverage or the vehicle falls outside the import conditions covered here.
Calculator.faq4Q: Will exchange rates and fees be updated?
Calculator.faq4A: The calculator uses a market-rate snapshot obtained at build time and displays its date. Default reference values are used if the snapshot cannot be obtained. You can edit the rates in More settings. Market rates and customs assessment rates may differ.

CountryPolicies.title: {country}: policy and cost notes
CountryPolicies.referenceHint: These estimates use the sources listed. Confirm relief eligibility, admission rules and charges for your clearance date. The total excludes the vehicle price, freight and insurance.

AM.scope: Ordinary combustion cars for personal use show the unified charge and age-based environmental tax.
AM.manual: Confirm the environmental tax base assessed by customs, gross weight and processing fees. Check BEV tariff quotas and VAT relief separately.

RU.scope: Ordinary combustion cars for personal use show the unified charge and clearance fee. If the records specify only a production month, day 15 is used.
RU.manual: Recycling requires checking documented power, personal-use eligibility, previous imports and resale restrictions. Hybrids and BEVs require customs classification.

KZ.scope: The listed recycling amount is for an ordinary direct import from China.
KZ.manual: Confirm the personal, common-tariff or restricted WTO route from the documents. VAT, registration and luxury tax require a separate check.

KG.scope: Ordinary personal combustion cars use the EAEU unified charge. The business estimate covers the verified ordinary petrol tariff line.
KG.manual: Personal clearance fees, registration, other business tariff lines, electric classification and quota eligibility require review.

UZ.scope: This covers standard M1 passenger-car clearance. The BRV is UZS 440,000 from September 2026.
UZ.manual: Freight and insurance to the border enter customs value. Core registration is separate. Plates, other services, EREV classification and uncertain age cutoffs require review.

GE.scope: The ordinary HS 8703 estimate uses rates effective 2 April 2026 and the basic clearance service. Select right-hand drive for converted steering.
GE.manual: The estimate uses duty without origin preference. Confirm any Chinese preferential certificate, grandfathered shipment or emissions approval separately.

AL.scope: Ordinary HS 8703 VAT uses customs-accepted value. An eligible factory-new, zero-kilometre BEV can be exempt.
AL.manual: Alternative valuation, technical inspection, seating and first-registration luxury tax need the vehicle documents.

TJ.scope: Ordinary China-origin combustion cars use the assessed customs value and 2026 rates. For personal imports, costs of delivery to the border are excluded from customs value.
TJ.manual: Eligible BEVs less than a year old use the relief scenario. Hybrids, unresolved age, assessed value and other preferences require review.

TM.scope: Ordinary private passenger-car estimates include the tariff, excise and clearance charge. Age counts full calendar years after manufacture.
TM.manual: Check eligibility for sports cars, converted steering, engines over 3.5 L, fewer than two front airbags or unroadworthy vehicles.

Assumptions.transport_not_in_tax_base: Unfilled freight or insurance is not included in the tax base. This estimate uses the vehicle price and known charges; adding quotes recalculates it.
Assumptions.am_electric_relief_assumed: Electric-car figures assume the reference 2026 relief scenario. Quota, production year and eligibility require confirmation; zero tax does not guarantee exemption.
Assumptions.kg_electric_standard_duty: Electric/series-hybrid figures assume the standard 15% duty without quota relief. Confirm quota availability and eligibility for the clearance date.
Assumptions.ru_personal_relief_assumed: The recycling charge assumes the lower personal-use coefficients. Actual concession eligibility requires confirmation.
Assumptions.ru_erev_hybrid_assumed: Range-extenders provisionally follow the hybrid combustion-engine route. Confirm the vehicle classification and applicable power measurement.
